description: This file defines the EnforcePasswordDao class, which provides data access methods for handling enforce password requests, such as saving requests, retrieving requests by reset code, and updating password validity status within an authentication plugin.

classes.name: EnforcePasswordDao
classes.description: Data access object for handling enforce password requests, extending the base DAO functionalities.

methods.name: saveEnforcedPasswordRequest
methods.description: Persists an EnforcePasswordRequest entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEnforcedPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves an EnforcePasswordRequest entity matching the provided reset code, if it exists and is associated with a non-deleted user.

methods.name: updateEnforcedPasswordValid
methods.description: Updates the 'expired' status of enforce password requests associated with a given user ID.
